causalRedClassification.rootCause: createSocketGenerationGuard correctly owns a callback only for the lifetime of the Promise returned by that callback. Several WhatsApp socket callbacks instead start non-durable Promise/timer work and return before those continuations settle. Once the parent handler returns, sessionGenerationFence in-flight custody is released; stop can invalidate and drain the generation while those old-generation continuations still have pending socket/state side effects. The same pattern also appears inside reconcileKnownIdentities, where avatar Promises are detached from the parent async method. Durable history-media recovery is not part of this root because it has its own persistent durable-operation generation/objectFingerprint fencing and is explicitly preserved by the RED negative proof.

Join nested reconcileKnownIdentities avatar work before the parent generation task settles. Preserve nonblocking callback responsiveness, existing logging/error quarantine, durable media recovery authority and current product behavior. Do not add or modify generation infrastructure.
